paragraphs.source_zh: 诸将已各自回营，只有近侍还留在帐内。家康只觉全身像是散了架般疲惫不堪。他看了本多正纯一眼，问道：“还有人要来吗？”

paragraphs.source_en: Just then, another man hurried in to plead for mercy: Ogawa Suketada, brought by Hitotsuyanagi Kenmotsu Naomori. Like Kutsuki Mototsuna, Ogawa Suketada had been among the principal generals who betrayed Ōtani Yoshitsugu only at the final moment.

units.source_en: Just then, another man hurried in to plead for mercy: Ogawa Suketada, brought by Hitotsuyanagi Kenmotsu Naomori.
units.source_zh: 此时，又一个人急匆匆赶来求饶，是一柳监物直盛带来的小川佑忠。

units.source_en: Like Kutsuki Mototsuna, Ogawa Suketada had been among the principal generals who betrayed Ōtani Yoshitsugu only at the final moment.
units.source_zh: 小川佑忠与朽木元纲一样，也是在最后关头才背叛大谷吉继的主要将领之一。

paragraphs.source_zh: 此时，又一个人急匆匆赶来求饶，是一柳监物直盛带来的小川佑忠。小川佑忠与朽木元纲一样，也是在最后关头才背叛大谷吉继的主要将领之一。

paragraphs.source_en: “Ogawa Suketada and I are kinsmen. Though the night is late, I have ventured to trouble Your Lordship.” The moment Hitotsuyanagi Kenmotsu finished speaking, Ogawa Suketada dropped heavily to his knees and began rambling on with apologies. By then Ieyasu had no heart to listen. Should he pardon the man, or be angry with him?

units.source_en: “Ogawa Suketada and I are kinsmen. Though the night is late, I have ventured to trouble Your Lordship.”
units.source_zh: “在下与小川佑忠乃亲戚，不顾夜深，前来叨扰大人。”

units.source_en: The moment Hitotsuyanagi Kenmotsu finished speaking, Ogawa Suketada dropped heavily to his knees and began rambling on with apologies.
units.source_zh: 一柳监物话音刚落，小川佑忠猛地跪到地上，絮絮叨叨谢起罪来。

units.source_en: By then Ieyasu had no heart to listen. Should he pardon the man, or be angry with him?
units.source_zh: 此时的家康已无心听他说话了，究竟是恕他，还是怒他？

paragraphs.source_zh: “在下与小川佑忠乃亲戚，不顾夜深，前来叨扰大人。”一柳监物话音刚落，小川佑忠猛地跪到地上，絮絮叨叨谢起罪来。此时的家康已无心听他说话了，究竟是恕他，还是怒他？

paragraphs.source_en: Ogawa Suketada’s case differed somewhat from Kutsuki Mototsuna’s. Mototsuna had abandoned the wrong side for the right, so there was some reason to pardon him; but Ogawa Suketada was related to Ishida Mitsunari. Ogawa bore much responsibility for driving Ōtani Yoshitsugu to his present end. A man prepared to answer for his deeds ought simply to await judgment in silence.

units.source_en: Ogawa Suketada’s case differed somewhat from Kutsuki Mototsuna’s.
units.source_zh: 小川佑忠与朽木元纲有些不同。

units.source_en: Mototsuna had abandoned the wrong side for the right, so there was some reason to pardon him; but Ogawa Suketada was related to Ishida Mitsunari.
units.source_zh: 元纲弃暗投明，饶恕他情有可原，可小川佑忠却与石田三成有亲戚关系。

units.source_en: Ogawa bore much responsibility for driving Ōtani Yoshitsugu to his present end.
units.source_zh: 大谷吉继被逼到今日这般地步，与小川大有关系。

units.source_en: A man prepared to answer for his deeds ought simply to await judgment in silence.
units.source_zh: 若是一个有担当之人，就该默默听候处置才是。

paragraphs.source_zh: 小川佑忠与朽木元纲有些不同。元纲弃暗投明，饶恕他情有可原，可小川佑忠却与石田三成有亲戚关系。大谷吉继被逼到今日这般地步，与小川大有关系。若是一个有担当之人，就该默默听候处置才是。

paragraphs.source_en: “Have you seen Kutsuki Mototsuna?” Ieyasu’s voice was cold.

units.source_en: “Have you seen Kutsuki Mototsuna?”
units.source_zh: “你见过朽木元纲了？”

units.source_en: Ieyasu’s voice was cold.
units.source_zh: 家康语气冷漠。

paragraphs.source_zh: “你见过朽木元纲了？”家康语气冷漠。

paragraphs.source_en: “Yes, my lord. Hearing that Your Lordship pardoned Kutsuki, Suketada too resolved to repent utterly and devote himself wholly to your service, and so…”

units.source_en: “Yes, my lord.
Hearing that Your Lordship pardoned Kutsuki, Suketada too resolved to repent utterly and devote himself wholly to your service, and so…”
units.source_zh: 听说朽木得到大人宽恕，佑忠也决心痛改前非，全力效忠大人，所以……”

paragraphs.source_zh: “是。听说朽木得到大人宽恕，佑忠也决心痛改前非，全力效忠大人，所以……”

paragraphs.source_en: “Though Ōtani Gyōbu was once my enemy, his conduct commands profound respect.”

units.source_en: “Though Ōtani Gyōbu was once my enemy, his conduct commands profound respect.”
units.source_zh: “大谷刑部虽曾是我的敌人，其行止却令人肃然起敬。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “大谷刑部虽曾是我的敌人，其行止却令人肃然起敬。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Yes, my lord.”

units.source_en: “Yes, my lord.”

paragraphs.source_en: “To keep faith, he continued directing the battle to the very end despite his grave illness. What a grievous loss… Would you not agree?”

units.source_en: “To keep faith, he continued directing the battle to the very end despite his grave illness.
units.source_zh: “为了恪守信义，他虽病重，却始终坚持指挥战事。

units.source_en: What a grievous loss… Would you not agree?”

ja.t: しいことだ……そなたもそう

units.source_zh: 真令人惋惜啊……你说呢？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “为了恪守信义，他虽病重，却始终坚持指挥战事。真令人惋惜啊……你说呢？”

paragraphs.source_en: “Yes, my lord.”

units.source_en: “Yes, my lord.”

paragraphs.source_en: Ieyasu paused and studied Suketada and Kenmotsu Naomori closely. Hitotsuyanagi Naomori’s face was redder than Suketada’s, and his head hung lower. The difference between a man who knew shame and one who did not was plain at a glance. Seeing how pitiable Hitotsuyanagi Naomori was, Ieyasu’s heart finally softened.

units.source_en: Ieyasu paused and studied Suketada and Kenmotsu Naomori closely.
units.source_zh: 家康顿了顿，仔细打量着佑忠与监物直盛。

units.source_en: Hitotsuyanagi Naomori’s face was redder than Suketada’s, and his head hung lower.
units.source_zh: 一柳直盛比佑忠脸更红，头垂得更低。

units.source_en: The difference between a man who knew shame and one who did not was plain at a glance.
units.source_zh: 知廉耻者与不知廉耻者迥然有别，一目了然。

units.source_en: Seeing how pitiable Hitotsuyanagi Naomori was, Ieyasu’s heart finally softened.
units.source_zh: 家康见一柳直盛实在可怜，终于心软。

paragraphs.source_zh: 家康顿了顿，仔细打量着佑忠与监物直盛。一柳直盛比佑忠脸更红，头垂得更低。知廉耻者与不知廉耻者迥然有别，一目了然。家康见一柳直盛实在可怜，终于心软。

paragraphs.source_en: “Suketada, you are related to Mitsunari, and for that alone you cannot escape grave culpability. But for Kenmotsu’s sake, I shall spare your life.”

units.source_en: “Suketada, you are related to Mitsunari, and for that alone you cannot escape grave culpability.
units.source_zh: “佑忠，你和三成乃是亲戚，冲这一点，你实在罪责难逃。

units.source_en: But for Kenmotsu’s sake, I shall spare your life.”
units.source_zh: 但看在监物分上，我且饶你一命。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “佑忠，你和三成乃是亲戚，冲这一点，你实在罪责难逃。但看在监物分上，我且饶你一命。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Thank you, my lord…”

units.source_en: “Thank you, my lord…”
units.source_zh: “多谢大人……”

paragraphs.source_zh: “多谢大人……”

paragraphs.source_en: “Do not thank me yet. I have spared you, but I place you in Kenmotsu’s custody. Reflect well upon what you have done.”

units.source_en: “Do not thank me yet.
units.source_zh: “先不要谢。

units.source_en: I have spared you, but I place you in Kenmotsu’s custody.
units.source_zh: 饶是饶过了，但我把你交给监物看管。

units.source_en: Reflect well upon what you have done.”
units.source_zh: 你好生反省。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “先不要谢。饶是饶过了，但我把你交给监物看管。你好生反省。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Yes… Thank you, my lord. Thank you for your mercy.” On hearing that Ieyasu had spared his life, Suketada repeatedly bowed his head in thanks and withdrew only after Naomori urged him to go.

units.source_en: “Yes… Thank you, my lord. Thank you for your mercy.”

ja.t: 「はい……ありがとうございます。ご
、まことにありがとうございます」

units.source_zh: “是……多谢大人，多谢大人开恩。”

units.source_en: On hearing that Ieyasu had spared his life, Suketada repeatedly bowed his head in thanks and withdrew only after Naomori urged him to go.
units.source_zh: 听家康饶他一命，佑忠顿时不住点头称谢，在直盛的催促下才退了出去。

paragraphs.source_zh: “是……多谢大人，多谢大人开恩。”听家康饶他一命，佑忠顿时不住点头称谢，在直盛的催促下才退了出去。

paragraphs.source_en: The rain continued to patter, stopping and starting; it seemed unlikely to cease that night.

units.source_en: The rain continued to patter, stopping and starting; it seemed unlikely to cease that night.
units.source_zh: 雨还在淅淅沥沥，时停时下，看来今夜是不会止了。

paragraphs.source_zh: 雨还在淅淅沥沥，时停时下，看来今夜是不会止了。

paragraphs.source_en: Takenaka Shigekado sent men to escort the party. Yet they could never have imagined that the person they were to escort was Ieyasu himself. They had assumed all along that the many wounded and sick men were being lodged at Zuiryū Zen Temple because they were unfit to camp outdoors.

units.source_en: Takenaka Shigekado sent men to escort the party.
units.source_zh: 竹中重门派来了迎接的人。

units.source_en: Yet they could never have imagined that the person they were to escort was Ieyasu himself.
units.source_zh: 只是这些人万万想不到，迎接的竟是家康本人。

units.source_en: They had assumed all along that the many wounded and sick men were being lodged at Zuiryū Zen Temple because they were unfit to camp outdoors.
units.source_zh: 他们一直都以为，伤病者较多，不便露营，才让他们住到瑞龙禅寺。

paragraphs.source_zh: 竹中重门派来了迎接的人。只是这些人万万想不到，迎接的竟是家康本人。他们一直都以为，伤病者较多，不便露营，才让他们住到瑞龙禅寺。

paragraphs.source_en: “My lord, please make ready.” At Masazumi’s urging, Ieyasu entered the inner room. To avoid recognition, he wrapped a large cloth around his head before reappearing before the others.

units.source_en: “My lord, please make ready.”
units.source_zh: “请大人准备准备。”

units.source_en: At Masazumi’s urging, Ieyasu entered the inner room. To avoid recognition, he wrapped a large cloth around his head before reappearing before the others.
units.source_zh: 在正纯的催促下，家康走进里间，为了不让人发现，他蒙了一块大头巾，方又出现在众人面前。

paragraphs.source_zh: “请大人准备准备。”在正纯的催促下，家康走进里间，为了不让人发现，他蒙了一块大头巾，方又出现在众人面前。

paragraphs.source_en: Shigekado himself, clad in a straw raincoat, was mingling among the men who had come to escort them. He alone knew whom they were about to receive at Zuiryū Zen Temple. Disguised as a wounded man, Ieyasu left the Fujikawadai camp in the rain with six similarly disguised messengers, accompanied by more than ten young guards, among them Kyūgorō Naritsugu, younger brother of Torii Shintarō Tadamasa.

units.source_en: Shigekado himself, clad in a straw raincoat, was mingling among the men who had come to escort them.
units.source_zh: 重门本人身披蓑衣混在前来迎接的人当中。

units.source_en: He alone knew whom they were about to receive at Zuiryū Zen Temple.
units.source_zh: 只有他一人知道将要迎到瑞龙禅寺的人是谁。

units.source_en: Disguised as a wounded man, Ieyasu left the Fujikawadai camp in the rain with six similarly disguised messengers, accompanied by more than ten young guards, among them Kyūgorō Naritsugu, younger brother of Torii Shintarō Tadamasa.
units.source_zh: 装扮成伤号的家康，在鸟居新太郎忠政之弟久五郎成次等十余名年轻侍卫的陪同下，率领着六名乔装打扮的传令使，冒雨离开了藤川台大营。

paragraphs.source_zh: 重门本人身披蓑衣混在前来迎接的人当中。只有他一人知道将要迎到瑞龙禅寺的人是谁。装扮成伤号的家康，在鸟居新太郎忠政之弟久五郎成次等十余名年轻侍卫的陪同下，率领着六名乔装打扮的传令使，冒雨离开了藤川台大营。

paragraphs.source_en: By then, however, Ieyasu was already dozing in the saddle. It was late autumn, and the chill of the deep night made him conscious only of the warmth within his body, a sensation that deepened his fatigue.

units.source_en: By then, however, Ieyasu was already dozing in the saddle.
units.source_zh: 但此时的家康已经在马背上瞌睡起来。

units.source_en: It was late autumn, and the chill of the deep night made him conscious only of the warmth within his body, a sensation that deepened his fatigue.
units.source_zh: 时值晚秋，深夜的寒冷让人只能感觉出身体的温暖，这种感觉加剧了疲劳。

paragraphs.source_zh: 但此时的家康已经在马背上瞌睡起来。时值晚秋，深夜的寒冷让人只能感觉出身体的温暖，这种感觉加剧了疲劳。

paragraphs.source_en: Looking back on the day’s battle, Ieyasu felt profoundly fortunate. Until the thirteenth, he had constantly feared that he might collapse from a stroke and suffer defeat. But the tension of the past two days had made him forget everything; apart from the excitement and exhaustion still lingering in his body, he felt no discomfort at all.

units.source_en: Looking back on the day’s battle, Ieyasu felt profoundly fortunate.
units.source_zh: 回想今日战况，家康庆幸不已。

units.source_en: Until the thirteenth, he had constantly feared that he might collapse from a stroke and suffer defeat.
units.source_zh: 十三日之前，他就一直担心会中风倒下，会失败。

units.source_en: But the tension of the past two days had made him forget everything; apart from the excitement and exhaustion still lingering in his body, he felt no discomfort at all.
units.source_zh: 可这两日的紧张让他忘掉了一切，除了残存于体内的兴奋和疲劳，没有任何不适。

paragraphs.source_zh: 回想今日战况，家康庆幸不已。十三日之前，他就一直担心会中风倒下，会失败。可这两日的紧张让他忘掉了一切，除了残存于体内的兴奋和疲劳，没有任何不适。

paragraphs.source_en: The gods and buddhas are protecting me! As sleep tugged at him, Ieyasu became convinced that divine spirits watched over him. “Abhor the defiled world; aspire to the Pure Land.” So long as he forever kept such benevolence in his heart, the gods and buddhas would never leave him…

units.source_en: The gods and buddhas are protecting me!
units.source_zh: 神佛在护佑着我！

units.source_en: As sleep tugged at him, Ieyasu became convinced that divine spirits watched over him.
units.source_zh: 在睡魔的搅扰中，家康认定自己身边有神灵庇佑。

units.source_en: “Abhor the defiled world; aspire to the Pure Land.”
units.source_zh: “厌离秽土，欣求净土。”

units.source_en: So long as he forever kept such benevolence in his heart, the gods and buddhas would never leave him…
units.source_zh: 只要永远怀有这种仁心，神佛就永远不会离去……

paragraphs.source_zh: 神佛在护佑着我！在睡魔的搅扰中，家康认定自己身边有神灵庇佑。“厌离秽土，欣求净土。”只要永远怀有这种仁心，神佛就永远不会离去……

paragraphs.source_en: Half asleep, Ieyasu dreamed that his grandmother and his grandaunt, Lady Hisa, were together devoutly chanting the Buddha’s name…

units.source_en: Half asleep, Ieyasu dreamed that his grandmother and his grandaunt, Lady Hisa, were together devoutly chanting the Buddha’s name…
units.source_zh: 家康迷迷糊糊中做了一个梦，梦见祖母和姑祖母绯纱夫人同在虔诚地念佛……

paragraphs.source_zh: 家康迷迷糊糊中做了一个梦，梦见祖母和姑祖母绯纱夫人同在虔诚地念佛……

paragraphs.source_en: Suddenly the horse began climbing a slope, and the steady saddle started to jolt. Ieyasu’s eyes flew open. They had already reached the temple gate. Compared with Fujikawadai, this was another world entirely: in the glow of the bonfires, the venerable temple looked like a jeweled palace in heaven.

units.source_en: Suddenly the horse began climbing a slope, and the steady saddle started to jolt.
units.source_zh: 忽然，马开始爬坡，平稳的马鞍颠簸起来。

units.source_en: Ieyasu’s eyes flew open. They had already reached the temple gate.
units.source_zh: 家康猛睁开眼，原来已到了山门前。

units.source_en: Compared with Fujikawadai, this was another world entirely: in the glow of the bonfires, the venerable temple looked like a jeweled palace in heaven.
units.source_zh: 这里与藤川台相比，真是两重天，在篝火的映照下，古朴的寺院有如琼楼玉宇。

paragraphs.source_zh: 忽然，马开始爬坡，平稳的马鞍颠簸起来。家康猛睁开眼，原来已到了山门前。这里与藤川台相比，真是两重天，在篝火的映照下，古朴的寺院有如琼楼玉宇。

paragraphs.source_en: “I have put everyone to much trouble. There is no need to make any further arrangements. You too may withdraw and rest.” After dismissing all the guards, Ieyasu still showed no intention of removing his armor and resting. Puzzled by this, Torii Kyūgorō Naritsugu urged Ieyasu to retire.

units.source_en: “I have put everyone to much trouble.
units.source_zh: “给大家添麻烦了。

units.source_en: There is no need to make any further arrangements. You too may withdraw and rest.”

ja.t: せずともよい。そなたも

units.source_zh: 不用再张罗了，你也退下歇息吧。”

units.source_en: After dismissing all the guards, Ieyasu still showed no intention of removing his armor and resting.
units.source_zh: 把侍卫们都打发下去，家康依然没有解甲歇息的意思。

units.source_en: Puzzled by this, Torii Kyūgorō Naritsugu urged Ieyasu to retire.
units.source_zh: 鸟居久五郎成次觉得奇怪，遂劝说家康。

paragraphs.source_zh: “给大家添麻烦了。不用再张罗了，你也退下歇息吧。”把侍卫们都打发下去，家康依然没有解甲歇息的意思。鸟居久五郎成次觉得奇怪，遂劝说家康。

paragraphs.source_en: “Two more men are coming.” Ieyasu smiled. Before long, men indeed arrived, one of them being the messenger Andō Naotsugu. “You have done well. I have been waiting for you.” said Ieyasu.

units.source_en: “Two more men are coming.”
units.source_zh: “还有两个人要来。”

units.source_en: Ieyasu smiled.
units.source_zh: 家康笑道。

units.source_en: Before long, men indeed arrived, one of them being the messenger Andō Naotsugu.
units.source_zh: 未几，果然有人来了，其中一个便是传令使安藤直次。

units.source_en: “You have done well.
units.source_zh: “辛苦了。

units.source_en: I have been waiting for you.”
units.source_zh: 我一直等着你。”

paragraphs.source_en: Naotsugu stepped close and reported in a low voice, “They have all departed.”

units.source_en: Naotsugu stepped close and reported in a low voice, “They have all departed.”
units.source_zh: 直次走到他身边，小声禀道：“全都出发了。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 直次走到他身边，小声禀道：“全都出发了。”

paragraphs.source_en: “And the supervising commanders are…”

units.source_en: “And the supervising commanders are…”
units.source_zh: “监军是……”

paragraphs.source_zh: “监军是……”
